column3: Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): UI callback that fetches the UI context with ui_get_ctx and raises key/action 0x13 via ui_key_invoke.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Scans the path for the last '/' then overwrites the 3-byte extension at the basename with a constant from DAT_ram_0207b84e.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Board bring-up that configures many GPIO pins (banks 2/3/4) then sequences hal_dacHPSet with XOSTimeDly delays before calling func_0x02058de4.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Board ioctl handler for 0x20000004 (set gpio/state), 0x20000013 (read saved state) and 0x20000005 (dac off).

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Computes the CSI/LCD crop and calls hal_mjpegAVIStart for 720p/VGA AVI recording, guarded by the record-active flags DAT_ram_020c8a01/UNK_ram_020c8a00.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Zeroes the file-list status/count/head fields at 0x020c8a3c..0x020c8a78 when called with 0.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Walks the entry table and returns the record whose status word is set and whose mask field matches param_2.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Returns the nth entry whose status word has the 0x40000000 free bit set, scanning the 2048-entry table.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Scans the entry table for an entry matching *param_2 (with optional status-bit match) and returns its index or -1.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Marks an allocated entry as free (0xffffffff), sets the dirty flag and decrements the entry count.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Sets the list dirty flag UNK_ram_020c8a6c to signal the table needs saving.
Track2 evidence-based naming (certain, names_01.tsv): Empty body that just returns 0; unused/stub callback slot.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Opens the .LST file (creating/repacking it if missing), reads 0x4000 bytes of entries and rebuilds the in-memory free/used lists.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Derives the basename from a path, appends '.LST' and copies the name into slot 0/1 of the file-list name table.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Allocates a free entry, stores param_2 words with the 0x20000000 mark bit and refreshes the entry count.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Recomputes the file-list entry count from the backing store.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Writes a count value into the per-slot list bookkeeping fields and clears the slot's dirty flag.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Frees every entry that is not locked and recounts, clearing the whole file list.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Adds or updates an entry (matching status word plus second word) in the 2048-entry ring and marks the list dirty.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Counts entries whose status word matches the given mask and returns the count minus one.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Finds an entry by mask, marks it deleted (0xffffffff), decrements the count and recounts.
Track2 evidence-based naming (certain, names_01.tsv): Empty function body; no-op placeholder/vtable slot.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Maps a config value returned by configGet (0x810000xx range) to a small enumerated index through a large switch.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Loads resource 0x810000c8, maps config key 7 to an NVM index and loads the matching record, updating the cached config.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Config-change dispatcher that switches on the changed key and applies it (resources, recording, md, sensor/AWB, app_context).
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Grabs a display layer frame, configures video for it and calls jpeg_show_or_save, masking an interrupt around the capture.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Reads an NVM audio clip, sets the DAC sample rate/volume (16 kHz path) and starts playback with a completion callback.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Thin wrapper that plays an NVM audio clip with the wait flag set so it blocks until playback finishes.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_01.tsv): Shutter sequence: captures a frame, powers down ISP/board outputs, plays the shutter sound and returns the result.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Opens NV item 0x27, mallocs it and caches the blob in DAT_ram_020ccbc4, returning the cached buffer and size via param_1.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Installs handler pointers into dispatch array DAT_ram_020ccc8c from task_map_builtin entries plus an optional {msg,handler} override list in param_1.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Periodic tick that decrements countdown globals iRam020ccd48 and iRam020ccd44 and calls ui_mode_request(1) when either reaches zero.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Key-event handler (event==1, action==0) whose only effect is ui_mode_request(1), i.e. a mode-switch key.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Stops the LCD timeout, disables USB mode, clears the two UI countdown timers and requests UI mode 10 when app_context.b2==2.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Writes app_context offsets 0x58/0x59/0x5b then enables the camera CSI interface via ax32xx_csiEnable, separated by XOSTimeDly delays.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Formats app_context.b8+1 into a 2-digit decimal string, sets it into window 0x16, shows the window and calls video_present(1).
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Reads the RTC via hal_rtcTimeGet/hal_rtcTime2String, sets the string into window 0xc and refreshes the screen when app_context.b2==1.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Shows/hides window 0x17 and selects indicator resource 0x80000042 or 0x80000041 from the record state app_context.b6d.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Key handler that decrements the numeric setting app_context.b8 and walks the preview/record state machine (b59/b5b/b5a/b5d/b5e) backwards.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Symmetric key handler that increments app_context.b8 and walks the preview/record state machine forwards, sharing record_config_set/FUN_ram_0204606c control.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): When the record indicator state app_context.b6d==2 and 800 time units have elapsed since DAT_ram_020ccda4, clears b6d and refreshes indicator and label.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_02.tsv): Resolves a file via work_service/manangerGetFileFullPathName, JPEG-decodes it (jpeg_show_or_save) into a display layer and posts message 0xd.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_03.tsv): when work_service reports files, re-renders current filename/SD status and hides child window 4, otherwise opens no-file window 0x20c433c.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_03.tsv): sets winSetName("play_back") plus resid, resets the playback flag and child visibility, then shows file/SD info; classic window create/first-show handler.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_03.tsv): key handler that increments app_context file index (clamped to work_service count), re-renders the filename and toggles child 4, with the b30-b33 end-of-list flags.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_03.tsv): mirror of the next-file handler: decrements the file index with wrap to the file count, re-renders the filename and updates child 4.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_03.tsv): gets display layer 0 frame, configures it with display_get_mode/hal_dispframeVideoCfg, memsets Y=0x28 and UV=0x80 (black YUV420), flushes dcache and shows it.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_03.tsv): reads fs_free_size, stores half its value as the active media free space, forces media state b4=3 and posts a queue message when it hits zero.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_03.tsv): creates VIDEO/PHOTO/AUDIO directories with f_mkdir, stops the SD, gets cluster size, opens the work directories and runs managerScanStart/FileScan/ScanEnd before unlocking.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_03.tsv): divides the cached free space by videoRecordSizePreSec bytes-per-second to get the remaining recordable seconds.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_03.tsv): when vr_get_state()==1, advances the per-second counter and formats an HH:MM:SS ASCII string into sRam020c33dc then redraws it via FUN_ram_0205d5a0.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_03.tsv): window open helper: looks up/reuses a window handle, registers the msg function, sends message 0x22 and returns the handle; used with several window descriptors across the UI.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Rerolls the RNG via FUN_ram_0201f388 until value%6 differs from the stored piece DAT_ram_020c647e, then saves the new 0-5 piece index.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Stores blit colour 0x8c8080, clamps the descriptor x/y (offsets +8/+10) to >=0, then calls blit_a.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Builds a full-screen 0x140 x 0xf0 clip rect and blits a 12-byte sprite descriptor through game_blit_sprite_clip using the screen context DAT_ram_020cd67c.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Looks up the sprite for cell type (param&0xf)+2 in table 0x020c6480 and draws it at the given x/y.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Walks the 8x8 playfield grid (DAT_ram_020cd0cc, stride 8) and draws every occupied cell as a block.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Initialises the playfield rectangle to left=0, top=0x14, right=0x140, bottom=0xf0.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Renders the decimal digits of DAT_020cd0dc by repeatedly drawing sprite[(value%10)+0xd], one row per digit.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Iterates the DAT_ram_020cd0d0 object list (0x18 stride, count DAT_020d6978) and draws each via game_draw_sprite.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Iterates the DAT_ram_020cd0c8 effect list (count DAT_020d69c8) and blits each using the 8-byte clip window DAT_020d69ce.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Per-frame render entry point that calls the playfield, object, player, next-list, score and effect drawers.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Appends a 0x18-byte record to the DAT_ram_020cd0c8 effect list, choosing sprite base+0x3c84 or base+0x3a50 from param_3&3.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Removes effect index param_1 by decrementing the count and compacting the last record over it.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Appends a 0x18-byte record to the DAT_ram_020cd0d0 object list, filling type, sprite, x/y and flag fields.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Removes object index param_1 from the DAT_ram_020cd0d0 list by copying the last record into its slot.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Clears both object lists, spawns the seed object and configures the player descriptor DAT_ram_020d69ec (sprite base+0x29c0).
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Calls game_init_objects and clears the movement direction _DAT_ram_020d69e8.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): AABB overlap of two sprite rects that writes side/flag bits into the output struct param_3.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Main per-frame update: for each DAT_ram_020cd0d0 object runs motion, collision, grid and wall checks, removing finished objects.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_04.tsv): Iterates the DAT_ram_020cd0c8 effect list calling game_update_effect_bounds and advancing only on retained objects.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Scans the 8x8 byte playfield DAT_ram_020cd0cc (8 rows, stride 8) and returns 1 only when all 64 cells are zero, i.e. the level-cleared test used by the play state.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Releases the four engine heap buffers (object list DAT_ram_020cd0d0, effect list DAT_ram_020cd0c8, playfield DAT_ram_020cd0cc, sprite base DAT_ram_020cd0e0) through the shared helper 0x02020384.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Starts a fresh game: score DAT_ram_020cd0dc = 0, lives DAT_ram_020d69fc = 3, then rebuilds the level through game_init_level.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Converts the pending command nibble (_DAT_ram_020d69cc & 0xf) into the per-frame step _DAT_ram_020d69e8 (+10 for cmd 1, +4 for cmd 2, -10 for cmd 4, -4 for cmd 5) and consumes it by clearing the nibble; ignored while the respawn delay DAT_ram_020cd0c4 is non-zero.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): State 0x1000 handler (play): applies the queued move command, updates the player, and depending on the result either decrements the 3 lives / posts app message 0x24 when they run out, or requests the 0x1100 level-clear state when game_check_field_clear reports an empty playfield.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): State 0x1100 handler: once the 0x20-tick delay in DAT_ram_020cd0d4 has elapsed it re-runs game_init_level and returns to the 0x1000 play state.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Screen tick: obtains the game framebuffer with window_fb(1), dispatches on the state byte (_DAT_ram_020d69cc & 0xff00) to the five state handlers (IDs 0x0000/0x1000/0x1100/0x1200/0x1300) and presents the frame with present_frame().

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Scans the 0x118-entry in-use table at DAT_ram_020cd1fc, marks the first free slot used and returns the matching 12-byte node of the pool at DAT_ram_020cd314.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Frees one node: recovers its index as (ptr - DAT_ram_020cd314)/12 and clears DAT_ram_020cd1fc[index] when the index is inside the 0x118-node pool.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Allocates the first four body nodes at (0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(3,0) with game_alloc_node, chains each new node to its predecessor through node[2], marks those cells 2 in the 20x14 map DAT_ram_020cd0e4 and leaves the head node in _DAT_ram_020d6a08.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Walks the node's (x,y) cell coordinate rightwards then downwards with wrap-around until the map cell at x*14+y is zero, and sets DAT_ram_020c64fa when a complete scan finds no free cell (board full).

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Places the food item: frees the old food node _DAT_ram_020d6a00, allocates a new one, sets x = rnd%20 and y = rnd%14 from 0x0201f388, snaps it to a free cell via game_find_free_cell and marks that cell 3 unless the board is full.
Track2 evidence-based naming (certain, names_05.tsv): Zero-fills the entire 20x14 cell map DAT_ram_020cd0e4 (0x118 bytes).

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Move validity test for a candidate cell: returns 0 when it lies inside the 20x14 board and does not overlap the body, otherwise posts app message 0x24 (game over) and returns 1.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Tears the game down: frees the node pool DAT_ram_020cd314 and the sprite asset DAT_ram_020cd318 and raises the end flag DAT_ram_020c64fa.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Fills the 320x240 (0x12c00 byte) game framebuffer DAT_ram_020cd67c with colour index 0xfa as the background.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Presents the game screen: takes the LCD draw buffer (0x02004840(1)), converts the game framebuffer into it, write-backs the data cache (ax32xx_sysDcacheWback), returns the buffer and triggers ax32xx_deUpdate().

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Masked, palettised blit of one w x h tile (rect param_3, source param_2) into the bottom-up framebuffer param_1, clipping to 0xf0/0x140, skipping pixels equal to the rect key value and otherwise writing the palette entry DAT_ram_020c64e8[idx] or the constant colour param_4.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Draws one 14x14 board cell at (row*14+5, col*14+4): type 1 = head sprite selected by the current direction DAT_ram_020c64e4, 2 = body sprite, 3 = food sprite (sprite base DAT_ram_020cd318 + 0xc4), 4 = solid border cell (colour 0xfe), 0 = nothing.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Redraws the whole snake screen: clears the framebuffer, blits every cell of the 20x14 map (deriving the head cell from _DAT_ram_020d6a08), draws the four border lines and flushes with game_flush_framebuffer.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Advances the snake one cell in the current direction DAT_ram_020c64e4 by allocating a node, testing the candidate with game_check_move, and then either linking it as the new head (freeing the old tail, or growing and re-placing the food when the head reaches _DAT_ram_020d6a00) followed by a redraw, or releasing the node.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Direction handler for the four turn keys: rejects a key that would reverse the current direction (1<->2, 3<->4), otherwise stores it in DAT_ram_020c64e4, then steps the snake with game_step_snake and redraws the board.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_05.tsv): Initialises the game: clears the head/tail/food pointers, direction 4, DAT_ram_020c64f8 = 0x22, decodes asset 0x18 as the sprite base, mallocs the 0x118-node pool (0xd20 bytes), builds the body, clears the map, places the first food and draws the board.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Writes the eight row pointers (stride 8) of the caller's 8x8 byte tile grid into DAT_ram_020cd320.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Sets the highlight tile value 8 in grid cell (row=rec[1], col=rec[0]+(blink frame==1)) taken from the 2-byte cursor record and stores 4 in DAT_ram_020c64f0.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Decodes pool param_1 with asset_decode, mallocs param_3 bytes and copies the block at offset param_2 out of it, returning the copy.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Blits one 30x30 tile from sheet DAT_ram_020cd340, selecting the sheet slot (stride 0x546) from cell value param_3 and placing it at x=param_1*30+0x20, y=param_2*30 (240x240 mosaic centred on the 320-wide framebuffer).
Track2 evidence-based naming (certain, names_06.tsv): Iterates all 8x8 cells and calls game_draw_tile for each cell with its stored tile value.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Binds the layer-1 window framebuffer to DAT_ram_020cd67c, redraws the whole tile grid and presents the frame.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Reads the 2-byte cursor record for index DAT_ram_020cd31c (and its 0x40-byte bitmap at +8, mirrored when the index is 1), rebinds the grid rows, marks that cell and redraws.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Decodes tile sheet pool 0x19 into DAT_ram_020cd340, resets the cursor index, clears the background and draws the first grid frame.
Track2 evidence-based naming (certain, names_06.tsv): ORs the 4x4 shape mask DAT_ram_0207bd54[shape*4+rotation] into the four uint16 board rows at the piece's x/y.
Track2 evidence-based naming (certain, names_06.tsv): Returns 1 when the shape mask shifted by the piece x overlaps a board bit that is already set (the spawn/move/rotate rejection test).

Track2 evidence-based naming (certain, names_06.tsv): Blits one 14x14 block from the decoded round background asset to the 14-pixel-pitch cell position (x=param_1*14+8, y=param_2*14+8) in the window framebuffer.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Draws the five decimal digits of the score field at +0x34 with R_drawAsciiChar starting at (0xec,0x41).
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Draws the 4x4 preview of the next shape (fields +0x2f/+0x32) at cell offset (16,11) in block colour 0xf7a1.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Promotes the next shape/rotation (+0x2f/+0x32) to current (+0x2e/+0x31), rolls new random ones, places the piece at column 6 and stamps it, or sets the game-over flag at +0x6c.
Track2 evidence-based naming (certain, names_06.tsv): Clears the current shape's bits out of the board rows before a move or rotation.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Redraws only the cells of the dirty window around the piece (rows y-1..y+3, columns x-1..x+4) as blocks, taking each colour from the colour map param_2.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Writes the piece colour 0xf7a1 into the playfield colour map at the current shape's cells (row=(bit>>2)+y, col=(bit&3)+x).

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Unstamps the piece, advances the rotation field +0x31 by +/-1 mod 4 from the input flag, re-tests and re-stamps, or restores the old rotation when blocked.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Scans the rows from the piece downwards for full 0xffff lines, collapses the board and colour map over them, adds the line-clear score from table 0x0207bd14 and reports whether anything cleared.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Full redraw of the visible 12x16 playfield from the colour map, then the piece's dirty region, the next-piece preview and the score.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Steps the piece down one row and on collision restores the row, unstamps the piece, clears completed lines and repaints the playfield when lines went.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Moves the piece one column left or right from the input flag and reverts the column when the new position collides.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Input dispatch for one event (1=rotate, 2=soft drop, 3=right, 4=left) that then repaints the playfield and presents the frame.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Clears the state and colour map, copies the 0x2c-byte board template from 0x0207bd28, seeds the random shape/rotation and paints the first field.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Decodes the round background pool 0x1c, clears and presents the window, initialises the round state and arms the 0x020c64f8/0x020c64fa flags.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Enables the ADC board path, checks the charger GPIO (port 4, mask 0x8000) and stores either the channel-3 ADC value (when <0x401) or the 2000 charger sentinel in DAT_ram_020c64f4.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Maps the sampled value in DAT_ram_020c64f4 onto a 0..6 battery level and returns 6 for the 2000 charger sentinel.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Table-driven PRNG that mixes XOSRandom into seed DAT_ram_020cd680 through table 0x0207bdc0 and returns the table byte at the new seed (drives shape/rotation rolls).

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_06.tsv): Draws a resource string (resGetStringInfor) into a window rectangle with alignment flags, clipping via winOverlapping/winIntersection/drawNotIntersect and drawRectangle borders.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Two-line helper that frees the pointer only when non-NULL (hal_sysMemFree); its only caller 0x02020DEC frees the tile-grid page buffer before reloading the next page.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Opens NV ids 0x15 and 0x27, rounds each size down to 0x20 and caps it at 0x4b000, mallocs + dcache-flushes a buffer per id and nv_read's the payload; sizes go to 020cd690[] and pointers to 020cd69c[], which 0x0202056C hands to ax32xx_dacStart.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Selects loaded NV clip 0/1 (0x15/0x27), optionally waits for audioPlaybackGetStatus()!=1 and again for it to finish, sets the DAC to 16 kHz with volume from app_context.b6b, registers a DAC callback and calls ax32xx_dacStart(buf,0x200).

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Samples FUN_0201f288 and only after 3 identical consecutive readings maps the reading through the 7-byte table at 0207bd8c and XMsgQPost's the resulting event to app_context._116_4_.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Moves the 22x15 tile-grid cursor by a (row,col) offset: writes the saved old cell value back, stores the new cell's old value and marks the new cell with tile 8, and for the pushable tiles 6/0x10 swaps them with 4/2 in the vertically mirrored board half.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Returns 1 (and advances the page index 020cd6b4 modulo 10) when the currently drawn grid cell holds tile value 8, else returns 0.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Fills the 22-entry row pointer table at 020d6a10 with param_1, param_1+0xf, param_1+0x1e ... i.e. 15-byte (one grid row) strides.

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Blits one 14x14 cell with blit_a into the framebuffer at (col*14, row*14+12) using a colour chosen from the cell value (1 -> 0x6c5bff, 8 -> 0xff8080 + records cursor row/col, otherwise 0x8080).
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Double loop over the 22 rows x 15 columns of the row-pointer table calling draw_grid_cell for every cell with its stored tile value.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Acquires the drawing surface with window_fb(1), refreshes the whole tile grid and calls present_frame().

Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Fetches page DAT_ram_020cd6b4*0x14a bytes from resource id 0x17 via FUN_0201dbd4, binds it as the grid row pointers, marks the cursor cell, then renders.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Grid click/tap handler: moves the cursor cell, re-renders, and if the page-advance check fires frees the page buffer and loads the new page.
Track2 evidence-based naming (likely, names_07.tsv): Resets the page index 020cd6b4 to 0, clears the screen with fill240(...,0x8080) and loads/renders page 0.
